name: adbShell
description: Executes one restricted read-only adb shell command against a connected Android device and returns command output. Only reviewed command families and safe subcommands/flags are accepted; mutating commands such as am, monkey, input, pm install, and settings put are rejected.

deviceSerial.description: Optional target device serial passed to adb -s.

command.description: Tokenized adb shell command. Only reviewed read-only command families and safe subcommands/flags are accepted.
